author: joelous
body:
Hi all,
I am partaking in a course at school (Informatics) that requires me to gather data on a particular issue and make relationships with visual representation! Therefore, I am asking you to do the survey about sugary drinks, and please answer them with honesty!
Besides, I know most of the Avicus community so I thought it would be a good starting point!


https://docs.google.com/document/d/1tlnha_ch62aleEWtkud3cc5wL4fE8MN3b-Kgf7KSZZ4/edit?usp=sharing​
Thanks!
